notes.title: "Silent But Deadly Night" Holiday update!
notes.notes:
The "Silent But Deadly Night" Holiday update introduces "Evil Santa" and "Frotsy The Snowman". These two bring with them a more challenging method of play with the potential for even greater rewards!

It also features 4 new Winter-themed levels, 2 more Achievements, minor gameplay tweaks and bug fixes.

Download this free update now! Happy Holidays!
